audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven chart rows handed the stage to Sion or called it even while their own why-strings describe Kled winning — whys[1] through whys[5] are all Kled-positive and the matchup wins 54.29% over 455 games.
audit.why: Sion is immobile with a 15s Soul Furnace and a Decimating Smash that only knocks up on a full charge; Kled's levels 2-3 re-E and his first-item spike beat that. Only 2+ items belongs to Sion, and that row was already correct.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Kled (7/10) as paired full+content rows; row 0 stays Skill and row 6 stays Sion. Result matches the packet chart exactly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text credited Kled's Bear Trap with percent-max-HP damage in three places.
audit.why: Kled Q has no percentHealth flag and Riot's text is flat physical plus a yank. The percent-health damage in this lane belongs to SION — both Soul Furnace and Glory in Death scale off maximum health, which is the exact opposite lesson.
audit.corrected: Percent-HP removed from Kled's side and stated on Sion's, where it changes what you buy.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that none of Sion's abilities were ever named, and the text repeatedly called his E an 'AOE shield-break poke'.
audit.why: Roar of the Slayer (E, 12s, 800 range) is a shockwave that slows and REDUCES ARMOUR on the first target, and knocks a minion back through everyone behind it. The AOE damage is the Soul Furnace re-cast after 3 seconds, a different ability. Decimating Smash only knocks up if he charges it long enough, so the tell is the wind-up, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Every Sion ability now named on the right slot with its cooldown; E described as armour shred, W as the 3-second re-cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both missing-interaction entries for this matchup were unaddressed in the prose: Sion sustains through chip via Glory in Death, and he invalidates stacked resistances.
audit.why: Glory in Death reanimates him after death with attacks that heal him and deal bonus damage based on the target's MAXIMUM health — so a kill without Grievous Wounds already applied often is not a kill, and armour stacking does nothing against percent-health damage.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing added to late, the resists-are-wrong-answer point added to mid, whys[6] and report[5].

edits.before: Sion has no kill pressure on you early — his Q needs a long charge to knock up, so respect it but don't fear his pokes. Level 1 is roughly even: you keep Skaarl's health topped and last-hit, he charges Q for farm. The moment you hit 2 you flip it — W gives the on-hit shotgun shots and your re-E (E through, W, E back) shreds him before his W shield or charged Q can answer. Bait the charged Q with a wide step, then commit; if you eat the knockup mid-E your whole all-in dies.
edits.after: Sion has no kill pressure on you early — Decimating Smash only knocks up on a full charge, so respect the wind-up but don't fear the chip. Level 1 is roughly even: you keep Skaarl's health topped and last-hit, he charges Q for farm. The moment you hit 2 you flip it — Violent Tendencies plus the re-E (E through, four attacks, E back) shreds him before Soul Furnace or a charged Q can answer. Bait the charge with a wide step, then commit; eat that knockup mid-E and the all-in dies.

edits.before: This is your lane. Your Bear Trap Q does percent-max-HP damage, so the tankier Sion builds the more your trade hurts him, and remount sustain heals back his chip. Pop W for the shotgun shots, yank in with Q, and re-E for the burst — he has no mobility to escape and no kill combo to punish you. At 6 your R lets you force the all-in or charge in for a remount kill, and it extends ganks better than anything he has. Watch only for the charged Q knockup interrupting your engage.
edits.after: This is your lane. Sion is immobile and Soul Furnace is 15s at rank 1, so bait the shield, yank him in with Bear Trap, and re-E for the burst — he has no way out and no kill combo to punish you. Do not answer him with raw armour: Soul Furnace and his passive both scale off maximum health, so resists buy you nothing here. At 6 your R forces the all-in or extends a gank better than anything he has. Watch only for the charged Q knockup interrupting your engage.

edits.before: Sion is the one Tank matchup that flips back on you late — by 2+ items his stacked health bar and zombie passive let him eat your full re-E combo and keep swinging, and his AOE shield-break poke chips you in the side fights. Your frontloaded burst stops being lethal once he is full tank. Win on the lead you built: take plates, roam with R, and close the game before he becomes an unkillable teamfight wall.
edits.after: Sion is the one tank matchup that flips back on you late — by 2+ items he eats your full re-E combo and keeps swinging, and Roar of the Slayer strips your armour from 800 range in every side fight. Worse, killing him is not killing him: Glory in Death reanimates him healing off every attack, so Grievous Wounds has to be on him before he drops. Win on the lead you built: plates, R roams, close before he is a wall.
